name: Play Music
definition: Listen to music, songs, albums, artists, or playlists on a media player.

name: Add to Playlist
definition: Add a song, track, album, or artist to a specific music playlist.

name: Book Reservation
definition: Book a table or find a restaurant, pub, or cafe for dining.

name: Get Weather
definition: Check weather conditions, forecasts, or temperature for a location.

name: Rate Creative Work
definition: Assign a rating, score, or stars to a creative work like a book, album, or movie.

name: Check Cinema Schedule
definition: Find movie showtimes, schedules, or theaters playing a specific movie.

name: Find Creative Work
definition: Search for or locate a creative work such as a book, game, soundtrack, painting, or show.

name: Play Video
definition: Watch a movie, TV show, trailer, or other video content.

name: Play Game
definition: Start or play a video game.

name: Open Application
definition: Open or launch a specific software application or service.

name: Get Creative Work Info
definition: Request specific information or metadata about a creative work.
